notes: CONFORMS since kb/Work PB5202. §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR3 gives every clause of a report file's description entry except REPORT its Sequential I-O presentation. The held adjudication (kb/Work PB4996 set 5) found every other clause bound with its sequential rules and only SR1's item screen of the CODE-SET clause missing, because CheckCodeSetRecordItemsPass.Run walked FileModel.WrittenRecords, which a report file has none of (§1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR4). Run now also screens the printable items of the reports the file's REPORT clause names at --std 85 (CheckCodeSetReportItems): a signed report item without SIGN IS SEPARATE is refused COBOL1672.

next.reason: 1985 GR3: every clause of the report FD except REPORT is as presented in Sequential I-O; the 1985 report FD (§1985:XIII.3.2.2) lists BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF and CODE-SET. 2023 §2023:13.4.5.2 'Format 3 (report)' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR8 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file') shares only BLOCK CONTAINS (§2023:13.18.10.4 GR1), the record clause (§2023:13.18.43.4 GR1) and CODE-SET (§2023:13.18.13.4 GR1) with the sequential FD. LABEL RECORDS and VALUE OF, which this rule gave their sequential meaning in a report FD, are gone: a 1985 report FD writing them is refused. A case removed, so CHANGED.
